name: Paths to the End
source:
You find yourself faced with an unexpected death and a strange figure who seems intent on guiding your way. What path will you choose?

[From [url=https://thecreaturesdesk.itch.io/paths-to-the-end-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你面對著一場始料未及的死亡，以及一個似乎執意要為你指路的神秘身影。你會選擇哪條路？

［摘自[url=https://thecreaturesdesk.itch.io/paths-to-the-end-demo]Itch.io[/url]］
